SERVICE MANUALS & SCHEMATICS
for vintage electronic musical instruments


Don't waste valuable repair time on the frustrations of searching the web for
a decent service manual, only finding the same useless scans, copied ad infinitum.

Here is a site with only high quality, high resolution service manuals, most of them
carefully cleaned, restored and often for a large part re-drawn. Here you will find no
unreadable 72dpi drawings, large schematics photographed with a smartphone or
manuals with crucial pages missing. Here you get what you need for the job and get
on with it. Free downloads of perfect reproductions instead of paying silly money for
an email with attachment, often a disappointment regarding quality or even usefulness.

ENJOY!

 # OF SERVICE DOCUMENTS    682

NEW


Everything is new here, except what you see. During the last months, all hardware
was replaced and software upgraded. Also changed provider, since for 4 months I had
no access to the server and got no useful help from their helpdesk, so therefor could
not upload any new, restored manuals.

Once more I paid for this out of my own pocket, but this will be the last time. When
people like the service but don't appreciate the hundreds of hours spent on creating
the collection below by sending a modest donation to keep the site alive, I can also
use my time for frolicking in the park, donating my extensive manual collection to
the paper recycling instead of running them through the scanner and restore them.
. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .

relevant pages from my database and created one.
